nodes.title: Blender path – set once (clean Blender recommended)
PixelArtistry · Settings (2K preset)
widgets_values:
### 2K preset – needs 16 GB+ VRAM and 32 GB+ RAM

| Node | Standard (01) | This preset |
|---|---|---|
| Shape upsample (`target_resolution`) | 1536 | **2048** |
| Structure + shape samplers | 12 / 20 steps, cfg 7.5 | **24 / 24 steps, cfg 6** |
| Quad Reconstruct | on, 1536 | **bypassed** |
| WTiVo `input_res` = `final_res` | 1536 | **2048** |
| WTiVo `proxy_points` | 12M | **25M** |
| LODTailor | 0.001 / max 6M | same |

**Why Quad Reconstruct is bypassed at 2K:** at 2048 its output made WTiVo's mesh balloon to 77–85M faces (~17 GB RAM with 25M proxy points), and LODTailor could no longer reduce it without breaking it (holes, loose fragments). Without Quad, the same 25M proxy points give a 43M-face mesh that stays watertight through the whole chain. WTiVo's `largest` mode already removes the floating fragments Quad would clean up. If a generation is very messy, switch Quad back on (Ctrl+B) and lower `proxy_points` to 12M.

**Loose pieces:** LODTailor can leave many small separate but closed pieces (299 in our test). Fine for renders and games; for printing, check them in Blender (Edit Mode → P → By Loose Parts).

Measured on an RTX 5080: WTiVo 3.5 min (43M faces, watertight, 1 piece), ~11 GB RAM and ~5 GB VRAM for WTiVo, LODTailor result 3.25M faces and watertight, whole run ~7.5 min.

---
### Settings by VRAM (WTiVo)

| VRAM | WTiVo input_res = final_res | proxy_points |
|---|---|---|
| 6 GB | 1024 | lower it if you run out of memory |
| 8 GB+ | 1536 | 12,000,000 (default here) |
| 16 GB+ | 2048 – use the 2K preset (01b) | 25,000,000 with Quad Reconstruct bypassed (see 01b) |

**Proxy points:** more points let WTiVo follow more of the raw surface – more detail, but also more faces, RAM and time. At 1536, 12M keeps the whole chain watertight; this 2K preset uses 25M with Quad Reconstruct bypassed – see above.

**Quad Reconstruct:** keep `resolution` at 1536. It flattens tiny surface detail – bypass it (Ctrl+B) if you need that detail.

**WTiVo `lambda_fill`:** 20 works for most models. 10–20 for small holes, 30–40 for big ones. Too high closes openings you want to keep (hoods, sleeves).

**LODTailor (step 4):** rebuilds WTiVo's 20–50M-face mesh with a fine voxel remesh in Blender (`relative_voxel_size` 0.001) and caps it at 6M faces – lighter, and still closed.

**WTiVo `component_mode` = largest:** keeps only the main piece and drops loose fragments. Switch to `auto` if your model has separate parts you want to keep.

**Holes in the result?** Run again – the structure seed is set to *randomize*, every run is a new generation.

**3D printing:** don't bypass LODTailor – WTiVo alone outputs 20–50M faces (1–2.5 GB as STL), too big for a slicer.

nodes.title: PixelArtistry · Start here
widgets_values:
# PixelArtistry · Image → Watertight 3D Model · 2K preset

Free & local ComfyUI workflow by **PixelArtistry**.

## How to use
1. Load your image in **Load Image** (green group).
2. Set your Blender path once in **Blender path** (purple group).
3. Choose the model with **Boolean (Switch to Trellis2)**: `false` = Pixal3D, `true` = Trellis.2
4. Press **Run**. The watertight model is saved to `ComfyUI/output/3d/`.

Same as workflow 01, with generation and WTiVo at 2048, 25M proxy points and Quad Reconstruct bypassed. Needs 16 GB+ VRAM and 32 GB+ RAM – see the settings note.

## What happens
Pixal3D / Trellis.2 → **Quad Reconstruct** cleans the raw mesh → **WTiVo** makes it watertight → **LODTailor** makes it lighter (Blender) and keeps it closed → **Fast Merge** welds duplicate vertices, so slicers see a clean mesh.

Settings for your GPU: see the note in the purple group.

## PixelArtistry
- Website: https://pixel-artistry.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PixelArtistry_
- X: https://x.com/philippsieben
- Newsletter FutureFrames: https://go.pixel-artistry.com/newsletter

## Built with MostAadTech's nodes
The watertight, low-poly and baking steps in this workflow run on free, open-source ComfyUI nodes by **MostAadTech**. He spent over a month building them and was a huge help while these workflows were made – please show him some love:

- **Quad Reconstruct** – cleans the raw mesh and removes floating fragments
- **Memory Cleaner** – frees VRAM between the heavy steps
- **WTiVo** – makes the mesh watertight
- **LODTailor** – builds the lighter or low-poly mesh in Blender
- **Fast Merge** – welds duplicate vertices for a clean final file

**Follow & support MostAadTech**
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MostAadTech
- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/MostafaAwad/membership
- GitHub: https://github.com/Mstafa-awad
- X: https://x.com/MostAadTech
